source.name: Theorems about the definitions of the features of the shape of a spectrum, checked by Lean
source.how: each expected value is proved to be the value of the feature's definition at the doubles nearest the stored values, or within half a unit in its last place of it, by the theorem its record names in spec/XtractSpec/Records/SpectralShape.lean; written by tests/reference/generate/lean_spectral_shape.py and checked by Lean's kernel
